context.description: The phase-1 runner reads readiness and completion from the machine

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-RM18.spec.ts (5 tests, 51 expect calls; my bun run: 5 pass, 0 fail, 116.4 s under load average about 140). GIVEN the runner after phase 1: the polled runner src/task/core/runner.ts was deleted by 120efaae43 (T2.12), and spec.md phase 2 says the polled runner is removed and H1-H16 pass on the actors, so the runner of the tree under test is the run supervisor. The test drives the real RunSupervisor.machine over a real Recorder and the real event store (runOf), on a SimulatedClock, and asserts runner.ts is gone. Only the unit supervisors and the batch proof are stand-ins (xstate provide); they observe each spawn and record scripted facts through the real TaskWorkers.record, so the unit under test is not mocked. WHEN a run proceeds: test 1 runs release-notes.spec from start to done. THEN starts a task only when the snapshot tags it ready: every task is spawned exactly once, each with tags [waiting, ready], machine state ready, the ready tag, and every after task, child and outside precondition trusted; test 2 negative controls on mapStates copies show the runner follows the tag alone: a ready tag added to T1.5 waiting makes it start T1.5 with T1.3, T1.4 waiting and T9 untrusted; the tag removed from T1.3 ready means T1.3 (ready in the machine) is never started while T1.2 is. AND no readiness check (test 2), no outside trust set (test 4: T8 trusted by a fact the runner did not record, a forwarded run.trust T8 and T9 records nothing more, stored outside.trusted is exactly [T9, T8], the in-flight trusting list is empty; test 5: identifier trustActive absent), no done decision (test 1: all tasks trusted with S5 held in verifying, machine active, runner still in running.main.active; test 3: a copy without run.settled rows, every unit trusted, machine active, runner still running, while the same facts through the real machine are done). AND never records run.ended in state done: tests 1 and 3 store no run.ended at all; test 5 scans the core AST and finds the only run.ended with a state is the wall clock's, state failed, plus the supervisor's own raised event; I confirmed by grep that no other source records run.ended. AND stops when the snapshot status is done: after S5's verdict the run machine is done and the runner reaches closed (status done); it did not stop before. Note for the owner: the Gherkin still names the deleted phase-1 runner; the wording could name the run supervisor. Every behavioural step has specific, discriminating assertions.
